name: Chimpanzee Banani
summary:
Chimpanzee Banani is a VR multiplayer movement experience that pushes arm-based locomotion to the next level. Inspired by Gorilla Tag, the game blends intense climbing, zero-gravity physics, and horror elements with social hangout spaces designed just for VR.

Move using your arms to swing, climb, and launch yourself across a variety of maps.
